roomId.description: The room whose epoch key chain is being fetched.

presentation.description: Must confer the `read` action at this room's scope. Reading the room and reading the parts of it written earlier are the same act, so they take the same grant; a separate one would be a grant nobody could explain.

fromEpoch.description: Return only links whose `epoch` is at or below this. The chain is walked downwards, so this is how a member who already holds the top of it asks for the rest. Absent means from the room's current epoch down.

limit.description: Maximum links to return, highest `epoch` first. A host MAY return fewer.

Response.title: Rooms Epoch Chain — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/epoch/chain. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/epoch/chain/0.2#response. Carries ciphertext a host cannot read, and — once the room's chain has been pruned — the room's epoch floor, which every party keeping the room's rungs or keys on a member's behalf discards below.

links.description: The links, highest `epoch` first. Contiguous within the range returned: a host MUST NOT omit a rung it holds while returning a lower one, because a member cannot walk past a gap and would read the omission as history that had been severed.

epochFloor.description: The room's epoch floor, on every response — whatever `fromEpoch` and `limit` the request named, and with an empty `links` too — once the room's chain has ever been pruned at this host; absent when it never has. A requester that keeps rungs or keys for the room applies it (`EpochFloor`): discards what it holds below, and never stores it again. `links` never carries a rung numbered at or below it.
